title: Remote access — keep the familiar controls

steps.headline: Keep Enabled, Password, Keep awake, and Add Device where they belong.
steps.changed: The familiar controls stay. Secure connection status and device access are improved within the existing layout—not a replacement screen.
steps.notice: You can still turn access on or off and keep the computer awake.
steps.risk: This is a simulated UI. No live settings change. Phone pairing and recovery follow separately.

steps.headline: Try setup inside the same panel—not a separate wizard.
steps.changed: Setup appears where it is needed, using the same controls and concise instructions. The public-name notice appears only when approval is needed.
steps.notice: Try Enabled, Keep awake, setup, and Add Device. All actions here are simulated.
steps.risk: Approving this design does not install Tailscale or publish a certificate.
